about: A bathroom with no leaks and no rework

Most bathroom problems come from cutting corners on hidden work: waterproofing, falls and ventilation. We do these stages by the book and send photo reports of each one, because once the tiles are on, nobody will see them again.
The tile layout is planned in advance: joints line up with niches, concealed frames and mirror edges, and cuts go into inconspicuous corners.

faq: How much does a turnkey bathroom renovation cost?

It depends on the size, tiles and sanitaryware. We give the exact price after measuring and fix it in the estimate; if CAS renovates, the total stays within ±5%. If the bathroom is part of a full apartment renovation, it is included in the overall price from $550 per m². The price from $550/m² covers works and rough materials; finishing materials, furniture and appliances are priced separately in the estimate.
How long does a bathroom renovation take?
We set the timeline in the contract after the survey — from 2 weeks; waterproofing and screed need time to dry, so we never rush those stages.
Do you renovate just the bathroom, without the rest of the apartment?
Yes, we take on bathrooms and WCs as separate projects.
